description: Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) RFQs, solicitations, pre-solicitations, sources-sought and award notices as published on SAM.gov Contract Opportunities (official US federal source), searchable by keyword, NSN or part number. Returns solicitation number, type, title, office, dates, short description and SAM.gov link. Small-value RFQs that DLA posts only inside DIBBS (behind a DoD consent banner) are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

query.description: Keyword, NSN (e.g. 4810011164869) or part number; empty = newest DLA notices
